The '''Moran Medal''' in Statistical Sciences is awarded every two years by the [[Australian Academy of Science]] to recognise outstanding research by Australian scientists under 40 years of age in the fields of [[applied probability]], [[biometrics]], [[quantitative genetics | mathematical genetics]], [[psychometrics]], and [[statistics]].

This medal commemorates the work of the late [[Pat Moran (statistician)|Pat Moran]], for his achievements in [[probability]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Moran Medal {{!}} Australian Academy of Science |url=https://science.org.au/our-work/awards-programs/awards-opportunities/moran-medal |access-date=2026-07-23 |website=science.org.au}}</ref>
